additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
mr. Guillaume raised this ticket regarding a FailsafeMode, from the SCB it's offline so I am assuming it's a faulty Router 1 since from the photo we are getting until the “Hello” screen. I recommend taking a spare router and LiveLinux USB, I send in attachment the config files.
PLEASE BE AWARE that the LiveLinux works a bit differently now, we need to have a keyboard from v6.X onwards. Here is the steps you need to do:
Turn off charger
Remove CFAST
Insert USB and CFAST at “same time"
Switch ON charger
Keyboard press ESC when you see Siemens logo with instructions to press ESC, to choose manual boot order.
Select USB stick
Wait for the magic
